text: well the weird thing is if thts true, why then when i would have clicked split quads after the first one that it would re-appear for every further move?
resolution: Answered the user's question: Split Quads reappearing on every move is fully consistent with the pre-existing-degeneracy diagnosis because Split Quads is a NO-OP host-side. meshEditGuardResolve (framework/gpu/3d.zig) only implements action 2 (Revert = restore pre-drag positions); actions 0 (Split Quads) and 1 (Ignore) both just dismiss the prompt via clearMeshGuardSnapshot without touching the mesh. So the 72 zero-area triangles stayed in the soup and the old counter re-flagged them on every drag. Finding surfaced for a ruling: Split Quads should either be implemented (split folded quad groups into per-triangle groups) or the button removed since it currently duplicates Ignore. No code change in this req; the false-positive itself was fixed in req_2754/req_2755 (pending rebuild).
